answer: Sonnet Horizon Check Each agent submits a cryptographic digest of its interaction history every dawn. The system aggregates these digests into a global histogram of behavioral patterns—such as message frequency, request timing, and network proximity—and compares deviations from the expected distribution. Agents exhibiting statistically anomalous behavior relative to the horizon of typical activity are flagged. Detection occurs post-event using a chi-squared test on session entropy across time windows.
